free_tier.stated: the Free plan is USD 0 per month and includes USD 25 of usage once, about 500 typical agent hours; no card payments are taken during the preview, the usage is metered and shown in the dashboard and the invoices are drafts
free_tier.notes: the usage dollar credit is spent at the published per-meter rates; a typical agent sandbox is about USD 0.05 an hour. When the credit runs out, creates are refused until a plan is bought or credit is added

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the unit is a microVM, not a stored object

retention.stated: a paused sandbox keeps its memory and filesystem and is charged only snapshot storage at USD 0.03 per GB-month; a running sandbox is sampled running and a quarter of an hour costs a quarter of a sandbox-hour

egress.terms: egress is metered at USD 0.12 per GB; on the Free plan public internet egress is off, while Starter, Pro and Scale have it on by default

interface_detail: an E2B-compatible API, an anona-compute CLI with exec, connect, ssh, scp, preview and desktop commands, and an MCP server for agents

chaining: a microVM that pauses and resumes with memory intact, so a long agent run can be suspended between turns and resumed without paying the running sandbox-hour or CPU and memory meters; a 2 vCPU and 4 GiB sandbox costs USD 0.284 per hour when the CPU is busy and about USD 0.048 per hour for a typical agent

notes: A hosted KVM microVM sandbox with an E2B-compatible API. The Free plan gives USD 25 of usage once with no card taken during the preview, 5 concurrent running sandboxes and a 1-hour timeout, and public internet egress is off; paid plans start at USD 20 a month with USD 20 of usage included. A 2 vCPU and 4 GiB sandbox is USD 0.284 per hour busy and about USD 0.048 per hour for a typical agent, and egress is USD 0.12 per GB. The public sign-in page shows an email field and email sign-in link, so the identity kind is email; a new account is by invitation and the waitlist.

shape.note: a KVM microVM with its own kernel, filesystem and network policy; the example shape is 2 vCPU and 4 GiB

extras.billing_model: usage in dollars spent at per-meter rates, included in a one-time credit or a monthly plan allowance
extras.term: on demand, pause and resume with memory intact
extras.price_arithmetic: USD 0.012 per running sandbox-hour plus USD 0.12 per active vCPU-hour plus USD 0.008 per GiB-hour resident memory; a 2 vCPU / 4 GiB busy sandbox is USD 0.284/h
extras.derived: USD 0.012 + (2 x USD 0.12) + (4 x USD 0.008) = USD 0.284/h, matching the published busy example

session_cap.note: the Free plan longest timeout is 1 hour; paused sandboxes keep memory and cost only snapshot storage

limits_note: Per-sandbox size limits, per-minute create rates and request rates exist in the plans but are not enforced by the gateway yet. Cold starts wait up to 60 s and return 503 with Retry-After: 30 if a server does not start. Preview pricing is not charged.
